Purpose: this image exists so the name-recovery grades have a subject whose declared names are stated in this repository. No method body, code range or unwind record is graded against it, so no linker map, unwind dump or disassembly is committed beside it.
Declared namespace: DisrobeAotProbe
Declared types: IGauge, Program, Thermometer, Widget, and no other type in that namespace
Declared type IGauge: interface, declares Read
Declared type Widget: sealed class, declares properties Serial and Label and an override of ToString
Declared type Thermometer: sealed class, implements IGauge, declares the field calibration, Read and an override of ToString
Declared type Program: static class, declares the entry point Main
Declared names the source spells: Widget, IGauge, Thermometer, DisrobeAotProbe, Program, Main, ToString, Read, Serial, Label, calibration, get_Serial, set_Serial, get_Label, set_Label
Trimming note: IlcGenerateStackTraceData is on, so the names the runtime still needs survive into the metadata string heap. Names reachable only through a property accessor or a private field are trimmed, so Serial, Label, calibration, get_Serial, set_Serial, get_Label and set_Label carry no length-prefixed entry in the committed image. That absence is a property of the compiler's trimming, not of the reader.
